question.label: Question
question.description: Opens by asking the viewer something directly.
question.example: Why is everyone in tech obsessed with taste?

bold-claim.label: Bold claim
bold-claim.description: A definitive, confident statement or promise stated as fact.
bold-claim.example: This is the only productivity system that has ever worked for me.

contrarian.label: Contrarian
contrarian.description: Pushes against a belief the viewer probably holds.
contrarian.example: No, you weren't born with great taste.

story.label: Story
story.description: Drops straight into a narrative with a time, place or character.
story.example: It's 1615 in a small village in Spain and you've just been handed a cup of wine.

curiosity-gap.label: Curiosity gap
curiosity-gap.description: Teases something specific and withholds it.
curiosity-gap.example: There's one thing nobody tells you before you quit your job.

how-to.label: How-to
how-to.description: Promises a method, steps, or a list of ways to do something.
how-to.example: Here's how I plan a week of content in 20 minutes.

problem.label: Problem
problem.description: Names a pain the viewer recognises before offering anything.
problem.example: If your videos get views but no followers, this is why.

result.label: Result
result.description: Leads with an outcome, number or proof.
result.example: This video got two million views with zero editing.

callout.label: Callout
callout.description: Addresses a specific audience or situation, including POV framing.
callout.example: If you're a founder who hates being on camera, watch this.

warning.label: Warning
warning.description: Tells the viewer to stop doing something or flags a mistake.
warning.example: Stop starting your videos with 'hey guys'.

secret.label: Secret
secret.description: Frames the content as insider or hidden knowledge.
secret.example: Nobody talks about what actually happens after you raise a seed round.

comparison.label: Comparison
comparison.description: Sets up X versus Y, or a before and after.
comparison.example: Same script, two edits. Watch which one you finish.

reaction.label: Reaction
reaction.description: Responds to a comment, trend, news item or someone else's take.
reaction.example: Everyone is talking about this launch, so I tried it.

other.label: Other
other.description: No speech in the opening, or a hook that fits none of the above.
